promises.label: Mobile volume growth Q2
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Our market position, customer engagement and manufacturing capabilities remain intact, and we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter-on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book.

promises.label: Vivo JV operations commencement
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We expect the JV to commence operations and start reflecting in our revenues from Q3 of the current fiscal.

promises.label: Noida facility operations
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Construction of our 1 million square feet facility in Noida with higher capacities for our anchor customer is almost completed. We expect the operations to commence from Q3 of this fiscal.

promises.label: Q Tech camera module capacity expansion
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We are expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech, which is an ECMS beneficiary for smartphones from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months, largely catering to a captive smartphone volumes in addition to deepening the level of manufacturing.

promises.label: Display facility trial and mass production
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: The response from various brands is very encouraging and the trial will start from the beginning of Q3 and mass production to commence from end of Q3 and beginning of Q4 this fiscal year.

promises.label: Microwave backhaul radios export
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Production of complex microwave backhaul radios for large global brand has scaled up successfully, and we expect to also commence exports of these products during the current fiscal year.

promises.label: Inventec joint venture operational
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Our new manufacturing facility addition to our current facility in Chennai for a 60-40 joint venture with Inventec Corporation, one of the largest top 5 ODMs in IT space is expected to get operational from Q4 of this fiscal.

promises.label: SSD manufacturing start
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Moving strategically beyond traditional end computing, and we are actively discussing with a joint venture partner to tap into the growth into the high-growth enterprise server and data center hardware ecosystem, which allows us to address a surge in cloud and AI infrastructure demand and will start manufacturing SSD from Q3 and also exploring other critical components such as power supplies and mechanicals, which will enhance value addition and margins.

promises.label: Tirupati facility expansion and fully automatic front-loading washing machine 9 launch
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Addition of our new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities from 0.6 million units per annum by another 0.3 million units per annum, including fully automatic front-loading washing machine 9, which will be launched in Q3 of this fiscal.

promises.label: Dishwashers and microwave ovens production start
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We have started production of robotic vacuum cleaners with healthy order book and are on track to start production of dishwashers and microwave ovens in Q3 of this fiscal.

promises.label: Lighting export deliveries to U.S. and Germany
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We expect to start export deliveries to the largest retail chain in U.S. and Germany in Q2 and Q3 of this fiscal.

promises.label: Mini LED transition to OEM model
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We have initiated mini LED production and will transition to an OEM model by Q2 of '27, alongside launch of sound bar TV sets, expanding our play in the premium home entertainment ecosystem.

promises.label: Rexxam Chennai facility operational
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Our new facility in Chennai will be operational starting August '26 with expanded capacity to meet the demand of our anchor customer.

promises.label: Telecom revenue
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: So, telecom revenues, please appreciate, we have grown from INR700 crores to INR 3,600 crores to INR5,000 crores and we feel, as I mentioned earlier, we're going to be somewhere between INR6,700 crores to INR7,000 crores in this fiscal.

reported.label: Revenue
reported.speaker: Atul Lall
reported.quote: Revenues for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, was INR15,557 crores.

reported.label: EBITDA
reported.speaker: Atul Lall
reported.quote: EBITDA, excluding fair value gain on the stake held by Dixon Aditya Infotech Limited for the quarter was INR472 crores.

reported.label: PAT
reported.speaker: Atul Lall
reported.quote: PAT after minority interest and excluding fair value gain on the stake held by Dixon in Aditya Infotech for the quarter is INR218 crores.

reported.label: Return on capital employed
reported.speaker: Atul Lall
reported.quote: Our strategic focus on balance sheet optimization and capital efficiencies continue to yield strong results, driven by operational leverage, high asset turns and potential capital allocation with return on capital employed and return on equity at 34.1% and 23.4%, respectively.

reported.quote: Our strategic focus on balance sheet optimization and capital efficiencies continue to yield strong results, driven by operational leverage, high asset turns and potential capital allocation with return on capital employed and return on equity at 34.1% and 23.4%, respectively.
